origin.description: Two files with the same lines.
origin.details: Two files with the same lines.
origin.example:
a <- tempfile(); b <- tempfile()
writeLines("hi", a); writeLines("hi", b)
compare_file_text(a, b)

translation.description: Two files with the same lines.
translation.details: Two files with the same lines. code is a callable. local_* is a context manager.
translation.example:
from testthat import *

a = tempfile.mktemp(); b = tempfile.mktemp()
open(a, "w").write("hi\n"); open(b, "w").write("hi\n")
return compare_file_text(a, b)
